name: Humbert's Sword
summary: Near Dun Garok, Humbert's Sword is missing from its owner's camp. Deathguard Humbert had left to gather firewood while scouting the dwarven stronghold on High Executor Darthalia's orders. Ironforge scouts took his weapon, and he fears Darthalia will learn of his failure.

sections.title: A Scout's Negligence
sections.body: Deathguard Humbert watches Dun Garok for High Executor Darthalia. He keeps a hidden post near the dwarven fortress. One morning, he leaves the camp briefly to gather firewood for boiling water. Ironforge scouts find the camp unguarded and loot it. When Humbert returns, his sword is gone, carried into the heavily defended bunker.

sections.title: Fear of the Rafters
sections.body: Humbert knows losing his weapon to the enemy he was sent to watch could cost him his life under Forsaken command. If High Executor Darthalia learns what happened, he fears she will hang him from the rafters in Tarren Mill. He cannot storm Dun Garok alone, so he relies on passing Horde adventurers to recover his blade before his commander notices anything amiss.

faq.answer: Deathguard Humbert is a Forsaken soldier stationed at Tarren Mill in Hillsbrad Foothills. High Executor Darthalia assigned him to watch Dun Garok, the fortified dwarven outpost in the southeastern foothills.

faq.q: How did Humbert lose his sword?
aliases: how did humbert lose his weapon
faq.answer: Humbert left his post near Dun Garok one morning to gather firewood for boiling water. While he was away, dwarven scouts found his camp, took his belongings, and carried off his sword.

faq.q: Why is Humbert so desperate to get his sword back quietly?
faq.answer: Humbert fears High Executor Darthalia will execute him if she learns he lost his equipment to the dwarves he was sent to watch. He expects her to hang him from the rafters in Tarren Mill.
The dwarven scouts carried Humbert's sword into Dun Garok. It is among the Ironforge mountaineers, riflemen, and officers in the bunker.

faq.q: Did the dwarves steal anything else from Humbert?
faq.answer: Yes. Humbert found his gear missing from camp, including his sword. The sword is the only thing he asks you to recover from Dun Garok.

Dun Garok is an Ironforge dwarven stronghold in southeastern Hillsbrad Foothills. Its dwarves help protect the humans of Hillsbrad and nearby Azurelode Mine, and its Alliance garrison is in direct conflict with the Forsaken of Tarren Mill.

angles.text: As a Forsaken soldier in Hillsbrad, you know the brutal discipline High Executor Darthalia enforces. In Tarren Mill, failure or negligence can bring execution, not mercy.
As a mountaineer of Dun Garok, you have no love for the Forsaken on your doorstep. Every chance to harass Tarren Mill's sentries and strip their camps bare matters.
As a member of the Horde, you strike at Dun Garok to weaken Ironforge's military hold on Hillsbrad Foothills and protect Tarren Mill from incursions from the south.
